breaking_news.headline: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
breaking_news.summary: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

breaking_news.headline: G7 countries reluctantly agree to tap their fuel reserves to help the U.S.
breaking_news.summary: G7 nations plan to release large amounts of diesel fuel soon, but European countries were not entirely happy about the agreement.

breaking_news.headline: New Hollywood era begins with an epic mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros.
breaking_news.summary: The Paramount and Warner Bros. merger has survived court challenges, public protests and regulatory scrutiny. Now, the Hollywood heavyweight, named Skydance, begins operating.

breaking_news.headline: Disney, ABC battle Trump's FCC in court over free speech protections
breaking_news.summary: President Trump has repeatedly called for Disney's ABC to fire late night comedian Jimmy Kimmel, for mocking him. Trump has also routinely denounced ABC's The View, accusing it of being unfair.

breaking_news.headline: As Taiwan expands Arizona chip plant, China warns against developing political ties
breaking_news.summary: The world's biggest chipmaker now manufactures at scale in Phoenix, as well as Taiwan. China is warning political leaders in Arizona to not get too friendly.

breaking_news.headline: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
breaking_news.summary: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

breaking_news.headline: Here's the latest sticker shock: Borrowing for a mortgage -- or a car
breaking_news.summary: It's not just mortgages being at their highest level in almost three years — but the cost of loans for cars and higher education are among the borrowing costs affected, too.

breaking_news.headline: Who will win the 2026 Nobel Prize in economics?
breaking_news.summary: A thinly traded prediction market offers a starting point. We explore potential winners and the big ideas that could earn them economics' biggest prize.

breaking_news.headline: Ten people linked to Kenya's first-ever Ebola case quarantined as screening concerns grow
breaking_news.summary: The patient passed through multiple cities in DR Congo, drove to Uganda and eventually flew to Kenya.

breaking_news.headline: Chemistry Nobel awarded for solving mystery of life's asymmetry
breaking_news.summary: The prize was given to the French and Japanese scientists for solving the mystery of life's asymmetry.

breaking_news.headline: Sri Lanka's ex-first lady arrested over alleged misuse of children's hospital donations
breaking_news.summary: The 73-year-old has been arrested over allegations that a charity she is linked to misused donations.

breaking_news.headline: Zelensky condemns 'vile' large-scale Russian attacks that killed 20
breaking_news.summary: Rescue workers are continuing a search for residents after an apartment building in Pryluky was destroyed.

breaking_news.headline: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia
breaking_news.summary: Fears that the death may have been caused by pneumonic plague has prompted calls for more transparency from Russia.

breaking_news.headline: Residents of kibbutz destroyed in 7 October Hamas-led attacks grapple with how to rebuild
breaking_news.summary: Three years on from the attack on Nir Oz, in which 47 people were killed and 76 taken hostage, some survivors have returned to live there.

breaking_news.headline: US death row inmate Christa Pike awake and speaking after failed execution, lawyers say
breaking_news.summary: A medical expert advising her legal team says the murderer of Colleen Slemmer is communicating in a "basic way".

breaking_news.headline: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests
breaking_news.summary: The step comes after several groups complained of police using disproportionate force towards teenagers.

breaking_news.headline: Japan beer giants raided over alleged price-fixing cartel
breaking_news.summary: Asahi, Kirin and Suntory confirmed their premises were searched by Japanese competition authorities.

breaking_news.headline: Equinor says it may stop investing in UK if oil and gas fields do not get go-ahead
breaking_news.summary: The boss of the Norwegian state company says further investment in the UK could be at risk if Rosebank and Jackdaw are not approved.

breaking_news.headline: Rainmakers: The drones used to seed clouds
breaking_news.summary: Cloud seeding is gaining attention as countries look to boost rainfall - will drones help?

breaking_news.headline: Froyo's made a comeback. But at £12 a tub will it last?
breaking_news.summary: Frozen yoghurt, which was a huge craze in the 2000s and 2010s, has made its return with multiple chains popping up across the wider UK.
